summary: Jan–Mar 2026 FFB 3,816.45 mt (3.71 t/ha), 23.34% below estimate of 4,978.62 mt (PA 1/2026).

Manuring behind: 204.80 of 337.95 mt applied by March (61%); 2025 manuring reached only 32% of the revised programme.

issues.title: 2025 monthly crop table does not add up
issues.detail: Agro 1/2026 Table 5 monthly FFB Jul–Dec 2025 (2,032.36 + 2,079.98 + 2,023.22 + 2,275.48 + 1,862.78 + 1,881.56) sums to 12,155.38 mt, but the stated total is 12,818.06 mt (gap 662.68 mt). The 12,818.06 total is consistent with PA 1/2026 (16,634.51 Jul 25–Mar 26 less 3,816.45 Jan–Mar 26) and the 12.45 t/ha yield, so one or more monthly figures appear wrong.

issues.title: PR24 ablation: conflicting advice
issues.detail: Agro 1/2026 (Jan 2026) says ablation is not required for PR24 given palm condition, soil and rainfall; PA 1/2026 (Apr 2026) says the first round of ablation in PR24 is scheduled for June 2026 (3 rounds at 2-month intervals). Management needs one decision.

issues.title: Harvester count differs between and within reports
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 labour table and contractor table show 53 harvesters (Tamarai 26, IMS 16, Berkat 11) against a requirement of 57, but PA section 6.1 says Berkat SB has 14 harvesters (26+16+14 = 56). Agro 1/2026 says the harvester shortage was resolved by December 2025, meeting a requirement of 61 at 1:17 ha.

issues.title: Labour requirement 82 vs 90
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 labour table gives requirement 82 (variance -3 against 79 actual), while the text and concluding remarks recommend 90 workers (1 worker per 15 ha). Contractor table requirement totals 79 (41+20+18).

issues.title: Contractor yields inconsistent with estate total
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 section 6.1 gives Jan–Mar yields of 3.85 t/ha (Tamarai, 564 ha), 2.75 (IMS, 302 ha) and 2.71 (Berkat, 164 ha), which weight to about 3,446 mt (3.35 t/ha), versus the field table total of 3,816.45 mt (3.71 t/ha).

issues.title: Corrective pruning progress stated three ways
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 pruning table: 438.60 of 664 ha (66.05%). Text 5.7.3: 436 ha (66%) with 228 ha remaining (table implies 225.40 ha). Summary item 10: about 430 ha (65%).

issues.title: PR23 fertiliser dose differs from programme
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 reports Mix B applied to PR23 at 1.75 kg/palm (1,750 g) in Feb 2026; Agro 1/2026 2026 programme sets the first PR23 Mix B round at 1.50 kg/palm (1,500 g) in January.

issues.title: Palm density (SPH) figures differ
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 area statement SPH (e.g. PM99 136, PM00 140, PM09 138, PM19A 136, PR24 141) differ from Agro 1/2026 census table (PM99 135, PM00 138, PM09 135, PM19A 135, PR24 144). Drone count of Feb 2026 results were still pending in both reports. PA also cites a 148-SPH planting design for PR24.

issues.title: Area figures differ
issues.detail: PR24: PA 1/2026 100.00 ha (says +2 ha ex-nursery) vs Agro 1/2026 98.00 ha. Housing/road 11.15 ha (PA) vs 10.37 ha (Agro); pond/river/steep slope 36.27 ha (PA) vs 36.91 ha (Agro). Agro 2.4 refers to 154 ha of P00 though P00 is 156 ha.

issues.title: Interrow spraying year programme typo
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 interrow table shows PM21 (66 ha) year programme 264 ha (4 rounds) while all other fields and the circle table use 3 rounds (198 ha); the year total 3,156 ha includes the 264.

issues.title: Sprayer earnings unit typo
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 5.1.4 and 5.1.8 state sprayer earnings as RM66.50 and RM76.50 'per hectare'; these are per day (3.50 ha x RM19.00 and 4.50 ha x RM17.00).

issues.title: PR23 palm age
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 9.1.1 says PR23, planted Dec 2023, was 30 months old at the 29 Apr 2026 visit; that is about 28 months.

actions.item: Expedite corrective pruning in tall-palm fields (225–228 ha outstanding, esp. PM02, PM04, PM09)
Expedite manuring to the revised programme (204.80 of 337.95 mt applied by Mar 2026)
Use drone census results to update SPH and compute fertiliser requirement
Keep harvesting interval below 15 days; adopt MRS of 1 loose fruit; at least 2 rounds per month
Improve crop recovery in ravines of old plantings (missed bunches, uncollected loose fruit)
Selective thinning of close-planted/etiolated palms in P15, P16 and P19; remove abnormal palms
Conduct regular rat and bagworm censuses (no census since last agronomy visit)
Install barn owl nests (none installed) and plant beneficial plants (Cassia:Antigonon:Turnera 60:20:20)
Census and debole Ganoderma-infected palms in PM04
Circle raking in tall-palm fields; touch-up spraying of broadleaf/woody weeds and VOPs
Control Oryctes in PR24 and prioritise overdue manuring in PR23/PR24
Resolve PR24 ablation decision (Agro: not required; PA: scheduled Jun 2026)
Desilt/construct drains in low-lying areas before monsoon; scupper drains, humps and sumps on roads
Evaluate mini crawler / motorised wheelbarrow for FFB evacuation and manuring; visit group estates
Standardise fertiliser measuring containers and use wheelbarrows instead of empty bags
Supply dead/vacant points in PR23 and PR24
Verify monthly harvesting interval records (discrepancies with previous visit)

LADANG SUNGAI PERTANG - FACT PACK (Prosper RE Sdn Bhd, Prosper group; Agronomy report cover also shows Far East Holdings Berhad). Estate taken over by Prosper RE on 21 June 2025. Plantation Controller Dr. Chua Chin Kok; Senior Manager En. Mat Zin Bin Mat Akir; Estate Manager Mr. Suresh A/L S Narayana.

SOURCES. (1) PA Report 1/2026 (Planting Advisory), visit 29 April 2026, review period January to March 2026, by Planting Advisor En. Mohd Sufian Bin Yusoff. Previous PA visit 9 October 2025; this is the 2nd PA visit since takeover. Field work verified against March 2026 progress report. Estate costing NOT covered because PINFOSYS data key-in is in progress (expected August 2026), so there are no cost per tonne or cost per hectare figures. (2) Agronomy Report 1/2026, visit 21 January 2026, Agronomist Mr. Chong Kuan Ming; previous agronomy visit 13 August 2025.

AREA (PA 1/2026, as at March 2026). Total estate 1,415.33 ha. Oil palm 1,341.00 ha: mature 1,030.00 ha (72.76%), immature and replanting 311.00 ha (PR23 100 ha, PR24 100 ha, PR26 111 ha under land clearing). Other: durian orchard 1.24 ha, housing/road 11.15 ha, pond/river reserve/steep slope 36.27 ha, TNB rentice 6.66 ha, unplantable vacant land 19.01 ha. Mature fields (ha, SPH): PM98 122 (139), PM99 94 (136), PM00 156 (140), PM01 85 (140), PM02 23 (140), PM04 87 (140), PM05 58 (140), PM09 39 (138), PM15 95 (141), PM16 78 (141), PM19A 42 (136), PM19B 20 (142), PM20 65 (142), PM21 66 (142). Average mature SPH 139. Age profile (PA): immature under 3 yrs 311 ha (23.19%), young mature 4-8 yrs 193 ha (14.39%), young prime 9-12 yrs 173 ha (12.90%), prime 13-18 yrs 39 ha (2.91%), old mature over 19 yrs 625 ha (46.61%). Immature area rose to 311 ha after ex-rubber conversion (PR2026) plus 2 ha ex-nursery added to P2024. Topography rolling to hilly, about 60% hilly; steep slopes in PM19A. Drone palm counting and mapping by PARAS GIS completed February 2026, results pending.
Agronomy 1/2026 area statement (older): oil palm 1,228 ha (mature 1,030, OP2023 100 ha, OP2024 98 ha), mature rubber 111 ha, housing/road 10.37 ha, pond/river/steep slope 36.91 ha, nursery 2.14 ha (empty, preferred for planting). Census table: total 170,186 palms on 1,228 ha, 139 SPH; OP1999 135, OP2000 138, OP2009 135, OP2019A 135, OP2023 136, OP2024 144. Agronomist says census likely outdated; P98 and P99 tentatively due for replanting 2028; palms over 25 years now 30% of estate; 154 ha of P00 have passed 25 years; slightly more than half of planted area is over 20 years old; prime palms 8-19 yrs 17%.

REPLANTING (PA). PM98 and PM99 replanting postponed because 9-month post-takeover yields were 13.44 and 10.39 t/ha and palm height is manageable. PR26: 111 ha ex-rubber, land clearing began January 2026, 55 ha cleared by March; planting planned June (seedlings from Cheekah Kemayan nursery); remaining 56 ha preparation by August with planting in October. Advice: 14-foot planting terraces and chambered bunds for future mechanisation.

STAFF (PA). No change since last visit. Manager Suresh (joined 21.06.2025), Asst. Manager In-Charge En Suhaimi Bin Sukarno, Asst. Manager En Alias Bin Ali, 2 clerks, 4 field conductors, 2 security guards, 1 gardener. Plan to recruit a Field Conductor for the replanting area.

LABOUR (PA, March 2026). 79 workers (3 estate, 76 contractor) vs requirement 82 in table: harvesters/pruners 53 vs 57 (-4), drivers/loaders 7 vs 6, weeding 10 vs 10, manuring 6 vs 6, security 2, general 1. Ratio 1 worker to 17 ha; 1 harvester to 20 ha. Text recommends 1 worker per 15 ha, i.e. 90 workers, with more needed in 2nd half. Contractors: Tamarai Enterprise 564 ha (harvesters 26 vs 28 required; total 39 vs 41), IMS Saranam Enterprise 302 ha (harvesters 16 vs 15; total 23 vs 20), Berkat SB Enterprise 164 ha (harvesters 11 vs 14 in contractor table, but 14 in section 6.1; total 14 vs 18). Agronomy 1/2026 said by December 2025 harvester shortage resolved, meeting requirement of 61 at 1:17 ha.

WEEDING (PA, Jan-Mar 2026). Interrow spraying 798 of 1,030 ha programme (year programme 3,156 ha); PM98, PM02, PM04 not yet done. Mist blower with triclopyr-butotyl; sprayer 3.50 ha/day at RM19.00/ha, earning RM66.50 per day. Circle spraying 818 ha vs 965 ha programme (year 3,090 ha); PM09, PM15, PM16 not yet done. Circle sprayer 4.50 ha/day at RM17.00/ha, RM76.50 per day. Circle raking needed in tall palm fields (PM04, PM02). Agronomy: inter-rows notably improved, soft grasses dominate, but incomplete broadleaf eradication in P99, P04, P09; VOPs significant in palm circles of P99, P00, P01, P02; P98 circle weeding poor (radius under 6 feet, strip spraying). In 2025 all fields had at least one interrow round; circle weeding only one round in P09, P15, P16.

MANURING. PA: as of March 2026, 204.80 mt applied vs 337.95 mt programme (about 61%); 215.20 mt delivered. Jan Comp 17.30 mt required (34.10 applied, B/F 2025 for PR23); Mix B 141.35 required, 101.55 applied; Feb Mix A 70.85 required, 20.00 applied; NK1 49.15 applied fully; Mar NK1 59.30 not applied. 1st half total programme 764.05 mt. Manurer earnings about RM70-72 per day (e.g. 2.00 kg/palm dose at RM3.00/bag, 24 bags/day, RM72.00). Agronomy: 2025 manuring only 32% of revised programme (191.16 of 597.31 mt); no manuring in 1st half 2025 except borate; urea and MOP unavailable, AS substituted at 1.5 kg/palm Sept 2025; kieserite and rock phosphate pending; immature PR23/PR24 manuring long overdue. Stock at visit: AS 899 bags, NK 12, ERP 391, Compound 12/12/17/2 716, Kieserite 15. Workers carried fertiliser in empty bags and used unequal containers; advised wheelbarrows, mechanical badang or mini crawler. 2026 programme reviewed, no amendment. Mature 2026 programme (kg/palm): P98, P99 NK1 2.00 x2; P00 NK1 2.25 x3; P01, P02, P04 Mix A 2.00 x4; P05 Mix A 2.00 x4 plus RP 1.50; P09 Mix B 2.25/2.00 alternating plus RP 1.50; P15 Mix B 2.25 x4 plus RP 1.50; P16 Mix B 2.25 x4 plus RP 1.75; P19 Mix B 2.25 x4 plus RP 2.00; P20 Mix B 2.00 x4 plus RP 2.00; P21 Mix B 1.75 x3 and 2.00 plus RP 2.00; P23 Mix B 1.50 x3 and 1.75 plus RP 2.00; P24 Compound 1.20 x2 and 1.50 x2 plus RP 1.75. NK1 = 50% SOA 50% MOP; Mix A = 45% SOA 40% MOP 15% kieserite; Mix B = 45% SOA 40% MOP 14% kieserite 1% borate.

PEST AND DISEASE. PA: no significant pests; Ganoderma (basal stem rot, unopened spears) in PM04; no barn owl nests installed, start 1 per 40 ha; beneficial plants Cassia:Antigonon:Turnera 60:20:20; rat threshold 10% fresh damage, bagworm 10 larvae per frond. Agronomy: no pest census since previous visit; Ganoderma negligible; barn owl boxes advised at 1 per 10 ha; sporadic rat damage in P98 and P20; Mg deficiency yellowing in P09, P15, P16; P98/P99 weak vigour.

CENSUS AND THINNING (PA). 288 sterile/close-planted palms thinned in PM15 and PM16.

ROADS AND DRAINS (PA). 2,553 chains graded with external motor grader. Backhoe 123 hours this month, 345 to date (rate RM45.00/hr, budget 1,320 hrs). No major drain work; desilt low-lying areas before monsoon; scupper drains, humps and sumps needed.

PRUNING. PA: corrective pruning in fields over 17 years (PM98-PM09, 664 ha) 438.60 ha done (66.05%): PM98 96%, PM99 81%, PM00 85%, PM01 70%, PM02 27%, PM04 21%, PM05 71%, PM09 18%. Progressive pruning in young fields PM15-PM21 (366 ha) 100%. Agronomy (Dec 2025): only 22% of fields pruned in 2025; severe under-pruning in ravines of P99, P00, P01, P02; frond stacking substandard on terraces.

HARVESTING (PA, Jan-Mar 2026). 53 harvesters on 1,030 ha, 3 contractors. Rounds Jan-Mar 5.89 (March 1.89). March interval 14-20 days (avg 15/16). Harvester mandays 2,614; productivity 1.46 mt/day (PM98 1.02 lowest, PM20 2.16 highest). Harvest rates RM43-65/mt; earnings RM52.20 (PM05) to RM118.80 (PM20) per day. Contractor results: Tamarai 6.00 rounds, 3.85 t/ha, 1.60 mt/day; IMS 5.68 rounds, 2.75 t/ha, 1.44 mt/day; Berkat 5.87 rounds, 2.71 t/ha, 1.05 mt/day. FFB quality satisfactory. Target interval 12-15 days, MRS 1 loose fruit. Agronomy (Jan 2026): intervals 16-25 days in 2025 (21-25 days in older fields Jul-Nov), many over-ripe bunches in P04, rotten bunches in ravines, oxidised loose fruit; harvester productivity below 2 mt/day.

CROP (PA). Jan-Mar 2026 FFB 3,816.45 mt vs estimate 4,978.62 mt (23.34% lower), 3.71 t/ha. Jul 2025-Mar 2026 16,634.51 mt, 16.15 t/ha over 9 months. 2026 estimate 22,671 mt, 22.01 t/ha. Field Jan-Mar t/ha: PM98 3.04, PM99 2.95, PM00 3.19, PM01 3.36, PM02 2.96, PM04 4.52, PM05 3.43, PM09 4.34, PM15 3.91, PM16 5.16, PM19A 1.75, PM19B 4.49, PM20 4.95, PM21 4.50. 2026 estimates t/ha: 19 (PM98-00), 22 (PM01-02), 24 (PM04-05, PM20-21), 25 (PM09, PM19B), 26 (PM15-16), 15 (PM19A).
Agronomy: June-December 2025 yield 12.45 t/ha vs estimate 10.39 (about 20% higher), 9.89 rounds. Monthly 2025 FFB Jul 2,032.36, Aug 2,079.98, Sep 2,023.22, Oct 2,275.48, Nov 1,862.78, Dec 1,881.56; stated total 12,818.06 mt (months sum to 12,155.38). Field 2025 t/ha: OP98 10.40, OP99 7.44, OP00 9.67, OP01 11.96, OP02 11.62, OP04 13.30, OP05 14.21, OP09 14.07, OP15 16.62, OP16 17.73, OP19A 7.95, OP19B 16.28, OP20 17.16, OP21 12.00. Agronomist expects over 20 t/ha in 2026.

RAINFALL (Agronomy). Data only from July 2025: Jul 74 mm/7 days, Aug 183/13, Sep 193/12, Oct 160/14, Nov 342/15, Dec 272/15; total 1,224 mm, 76 rain days. Rain gauge relocated to open area.

IMMATURE. PR23 (100 ha, planted Dec 2023, target 136 SPH): scout harvesting since Jan 2026; Mix B 1.75 kg/palm Feb 2026; rat and Oryctes below 3%. Agronomy: vigour below optimum, excessive frond removal, rotten bunches and loose fruit left, weeding delayed. PR24 (100 ha PA / 98 ha Agro, planted Dec 2024, 148 SPH design): Comp 1.20 kg/palm Jan and Mar 2026; PA says first ablation June 2026; Agronomy says ablation not needed; severe Oryctes, declining after carbofuran; PJ cover climbing palms.

MECHANISATION (PA). Mist blower spraying started; consider mini crawler or motorised wheelbarrow for FFB evacuation and manuring; visit group estates.
